findings.title: Adjustments file matches the period and functional currency
findings.detail: manual_adjustments.json declares 2024-Q4 / USD; the run is 2024-Q4 / USD.

findings.title: Every foreign-currency row has a rate
No translation relies on an estimated rate
findings.detail: trial_balance.csv row 4 (GBP 412,300.00) has no period_end rate, so it uses the opening rate 1.251 (last period's closing rate, a point-in-time rate like the missing one). Across the available GBP rates its USD value moves by 5,359.90, against materiality of 365,162.00.
findings.action: Get the period-end rate from treasury and re-run, or sign off on the estimate.

findings.title: Ledger balances after translation and posting
findings.detail: Debits minus credits = 177,100.30. Breakdown: -4,800.00 already in trial_balance.csv at face value; 181,900.30 from translating foreign-currency rows with no offsetting entry.
findings.action: Approve the proposed entries in a review file (template: reviews/2024-Q4.json), or fix the source export, then re-run.

proposals.memo: Offsets the translation uplift on the foreign-currency TB rows.
proposals.explanation: Translating foreign-currency rows at period rates changes their USD value by 181,900.30, and no other row offsets it: the source TB only balances at face value. Post the offset to one of: 7310 (remeasurement of monetary items to P&L, right for a USD-functional entity); 3310 (translation of a foreign operation to the OCI reserve). The amount assumes the ERP carried these rows at face value; confirm (docs/questions.md Q1).

proposals.memo: Source TB difference parked in suspense pending investigation.
proposals.explanation: The remaining 4,800.00 is already in trial_balance.csv (debits 71,072,200.00 vs credits 71,077,000.00 at face value). It is below materiality (365,162.00), so it can be parked in 9999 Suspense while the ERP export is investigated. It is never spread across accounts.

findings.title: Every adjustment is posted or has a reviewer decision
findings.detail: JE-002 REJECTED, JE-003 QUARANTINED, JE-005 QUARANTINED, JE-008 REJECTED (reasons in the adjustments table).
findings.action: Correct and resubmit, or record a decision in the review file.

findings.title: Every trial-balance account maps to the COA
findings.detail: 9999 'Suspense - Unmapped' (ORPHAN, balance 12,400.00; no account fits). Shown on the balance sheet as suspense, never dropped.
findings.action: Find out what was posted there and map it in the review file, or reclass it in the ERP.

findings.title: Every prior-period account maps to the COA
findings.detail: 6905 'Sundry Operating Expenses' (SUGGESTED; suggested 6900 Other Operating Expenses (0.816)). Needed for comparatives and the equity roll-forward.

findings.title: Each account/currency appears once in the trial balance
findings.detail: 6310 Travel and Entertainment has 2 USD rows (row 48: 245,000.00, row 49: 38,500.00), summed to 283,500.00. Right for split postings, wrong for a duplicated export line.
findings.action: Confirm against the ERP account detail.

findings.title: Every source row and posted line lands in exactly one statement line
Every statement line equals the sum of its lineage
Assets + suspense = liabilities + equity
findings.detail: Assets 36,218,200.30 + suspense 12,400.00 vs liabilities 18,770,000.00 + equity 17,283,500.00: difference 177,100.30. Fully explained by the ledger imbalance (see LEDGER_BALANCED).

findings.title: Net income ties from P&L to retained earnings
findings.detail: P&L net income 4,783,500.00, subtotal ladder 4,783,500.00. Retained earnings on the balance sheet 12,023,500.00; recomputed from the raw TB, posted entries and net income: 12,023,500.00.

findings.title: Prior-period trial balance balances
findings.detail: prior_period_tb.csv is out of balance by 2,832,800.00 at face value and has P&L rows only for ['6905']: it looks like a pre-close TB with the P&L detail missing, so it can't serve as comparatives as-is.
findings.action: Request the full prior-period TB (with P&L detail) from the ERP.

findings.title: Opening retained earnings roll from the prior period
findings.detail: Opening retained earnings in the current TB are 7,240,000.00; the prior TB shows 5,180,000.00. If the prior TB is pre-close with P&L detail missing, prior net income is about 2,700,800.00 and prior closing RE about 7,880,800.00, so opening RE is 640,800.00 lower than it should be (dividends? a prior-period restatement?). Doesn't change this period's BS or P&L; blocks the Statement of Changes in Equity.
findings.action: Confirm dividends and any restatement with the controller (docs/questions.md Q3).
